fields.label: Pay Treatment
fields.description: How a day of this leave is paid. 'Partially Paid' and 'Unpaid' are the mechanism for a statutorily tiered leave (e.g. sick leave with a full-pay band, a reduced-pay band and an unpaid band): declare one row per band, each with its own Frappe Leave Type. Leave this on 'Full Pay' unless the client has confirmed the split.

fields.label: Paid Fraction of Daily Salary
fields.description: Fraction of a normal day's salary still PAID on this leave: 0.5 = half pay. Must be strictly between 0 and 1. Maps to Leave Type.fraction_of_daily_salary_per_leave, which Salary Slip reads.

fields.label: Frappe Leave Type (auto-create name)
fields.description: Leave type name that will be created in Frappe HRMS
